channel.title: Togo - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Togo, every source cited.

item.title: ECOWAS court presses Togo on constitutional reform
item.description: The regional court sent a reminder to Togo's Justice Minister about its January 29, 2026 ruling.

item.title: UDS-TOGO calls for national dialogue amid political deadlock
item.description: The party seeks constitutional reforms and an amnesty law to foster national reconciliation and restore order.

item.title: Lomé university hosts legal debate on judicial sovereignty
item.description: Jurists from eight countries discuss limits of regional court power over national laws.

item.title: Burkina Faso reinstates death penalty for economic crimes
item.description: The new penal code also imposes life imprisonment and triple fines for public fund embezzlement.
